info.title: ConsentLedger API
info.description:
Data-sharing hub with per-field, purpose-bound consent enforced by PostgreSQL row-level security, a hash-chained audit log and AI anomaly detection.

**Auth**: sign in via `POST /api/auth/login` (session cookie) or use the *Authorize* button (bearer token from `POST /api/auth/token`). Demo accounts use password `demo123`, e.g. `owner@hope.org`, `funder@globalfund.org`, `auditor@transparency.org`, `admin@consentledger.org`.

**Errors** are always `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}}`.
